name: shared-rules-custom-repo
description: Add-on to shared-rules: loads the rules from a git repo you choose into ~/.claude/rules/shared-rules-custom-repo/, next to or instead of the bundled set. New and changed rules apply at once, or only after you approve them.

rules_repo.title: Rules repository
rules_repo.description: Git URL of your rules repo. Its rules/ folder is loaded. Public repos, or private ones your git credentials can already read; do not put a token in the URL.

update_mode.title: Rule updates
update_mode.description: ask: new or changed rules wait until you approve them in a session. auto: they load as soon as they are published.
